## Failure mode

What repeatable problem does this change address?

## Behavior after this change

What should the agent do differently?

## Why this layer

Why does the change belong in the root skill, a reference, an example, or tooling?

## Evidence / example

Show one concrete task, before/after example, or reproduction that demonstrates the improvement.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept project-specific or private context out of the public skill.
- [ ] I avoided duplicating an existing rule.
- [ ] I kept always-loaded instructions as small as practical.
- [ ] I ran `python scripts/validate.py`.
- [ ] I updated docs/examples when behavior or installation changed.
